author: SuperCarlinBrothers
description:
Can Death Eaters cast a Patronus? Dolores Umbridge can, but could Bellatrix Lestrange or Lord Voldemort do the same? The answer might reveal something surprising about Severus Snape.

Today J dives into the Wizarding World of Harry Potter to investigate the Patronus Charm, the Death Eaters’ alliance with Dementors, and what it really takes to cast Expecto Patronum. Are happy memories enough, or could the condition of a wizard’s soul change everything?

From Umbridge’s cat to Snape’s silver doe, we’re following the evidence toward a theory about one of the wizarding world’s most mysterious spells.

Do you think Bellatrix could produce a Patronus? Let us know in the towel section down below!
